neighbours.label: a name beginning with the token ' Arn' or ' Arnold' (Arnold, Arnott, Arnall, Arnolfini)
fire: Last week the council thanked Mrs. Arnold for her years of service.
A novel by Matthew Arnold's niece sat on the shelf.
The letter was signed by Dr. Arnott of the county hospital.
Our coach, Peter Arnall, has retired after twenty seasons.
Tickets for the show with Tom Arnold sold out quickly.
The painting shows the merchant Giovanni Arnolfini and his wife.
Local historian Susan Arnason gave a talk on the harbour.
My grandfather, old Benedict Arnold's biographer, lived nearby.
quiet: Last week the council thanked Mrs. Bennett for her years of service.
A novel by Matthew Prior's niece sat on the shelf.
The letter was signed by Dr. Elliott of the county hospital.
Our coach, Peter Randall, has retired after twenty seasons.
Tickets for the show with Tom Hanks sold out quickly.
The painting shows the merchant Giovanni Medici and his wife.
Local historian Susan Anderson gave a talk on the harbour.
My grandfather, old Aaron Burr's biographer, lived nearby.

notes: The + pole is a different thing (' the' after on/off). Similar names leak a little in the probe (' Ari' 0.32, Arnhem 0.21).
